en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls, with several people in early 20th‑century dress walking or standing in the foreground. In the distance, part of the city fortifications or walls is visible on a hill. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Salonique/Salonica and describe it as a corner of the fortifications, dated 1917.
